776a9ab8-9cb3-570a-a9fb-8e7d634cde52.speaker: Attorney Sprague
776a9ab8-9cb3-570a-a9fb-8e7d634cde52.text: Further directing your attention to approximately 6:11 PM. At that time, did you receive a dispatch to go to 47 Summer Street in Duxbury?

dc4a0f18-275c-5112-a86e-0600a13109a7.speaker: Stephen Hall
dc4a0f18-275c-5112-a86e-0600a13109a7.text: I was at the Lincoln Street Fields in Duxbury.

6b0019cc-055d-5307-a017-5dc7be566b74.speaker: Attorney Sprague
6b0019cc-055d-5307-a017-5dc7be566b74.text: And so how long did it take you to get from there to 47 Summer Street?

6206a9ed-f783-5b07-aafc-a3db6550a167.speaker: Attorney Sprague
6206a9ed-f783-5b07-aafc-a3db6550a167.text: And what did you see when you arrived there?

a5a92993-ac7f-57c3-a7a5-b3887523bede.speaker: Stephen Hall
a5a92993-ac7f-57c3-a7a5-b3887523bede.text: When I arrived, it was just a house. There was a gate open on the left side of the house.

64835323-008b-5077-a631-6c8424c7c1ad.speaker: Stephen Hall
64835323-008b-5077-a631-6c8424c7c1ad.text: I arrived simultaneously with Officer Josephine.

92510ecb-2755-5bca-a628-738a11c365cb.speaker: Attorney Sprague
92510ecb-2755-5bca-a628-738a11c365cb.text: Okay. And did you encounter a male in the backyard?

ddd2095b-6d87-5f2a-a016-04861fa2c670.speaker: Attorney Sprague
ddd2095b-6d87-5f2a-a016-04861fa2c670.text: And did you later learn his name was Patrick Clancy?

d683f323-7d41-5dd0-ad4f-d6936c703a99.speaker: Stephen Hall
d683f323-7d41-5dd0-ad4f-d6936c703a99.text: She had cuts to both wrists and to the left side of her neck.

9faf9eb7-de77-5553-a896-b1f89304c5e5.speaker: Attorney Sprague
9faf9eb7-de77-5553-a896-b1f89304c5e5.text: While you and Officer Josephine are there, do other first responders such as firefighters start to arrive?

36dd5add-edf0-5eb8-a463-1bedac596593.speaker: Stephen Hall
36dd5add-edf0-5eb8-a463-1bedac596593.text: Yes. They started to arrive and I went to gate to direct them where to go.

134e2e9e-ddb4-59ff-ab3c-c6b97ed1d505.speaker: Attorney Sprague
134e2e9e-ddb4-59ff-ab3c-c6b97ed1d505.text: While you were doing this, did Patrick Clancy stay with you?

76011220-a115-5880-a539-bc23fd9e3ff5.speaker: Stephen Hall
76011220-a115-5880-a539-bc23fd9e3ff5.text: At one point, he went inside to say he was going to check on his children.

5fa7ae22-a22c-5bee-ad5e-a86a88e35afa.speaker: Attorney Sprague
5fa7ae22-a22c-5bee-ad5e-a86a88e35afa.text: Shortly after Patrick Clancy went inside the home, did you receive a call on your radio?

65928b36-81d5-59fb-afcf-a46d28e5347e.speaker: Stephen Hall
65928b36-81d5-59fb-afcf-a46d28e5347e.text: Dispatch said that he couldn't wake them up.

89348a2f-be9d-52ba-a417-bf810ee936d2.speaker: Attorney Sprague
89348a2f-be9d-52ba-a417-bf810ee936d2.text: And did you know what they were talking about when you initially heard that?

b4d5d106-d269-5e15-a144-f492744cc2f0.speaker: Attorney Sprague
b4d5d106-d269-5e15-a144-f492744cc2f0.text: Did something then catch your attention?

0b766e32-4b73-5646-a568-0abcb3263c72.speaker: Stephen Hall
0b766e32-4b73-5646-a568-0abcb3263c72.text: Yeah, I heard a loud scream from inside.

da456598-b523-5f62-a3eb-81bc75eabc2f.speaker: Attorney Sprague
da456598-b523-5f62-a3eb-81bc75eabc2f.text: When you heard that screaming, what did you do?

8a1ccee5-03e0-57f8-a392-b32c6d34ece6.speaker: Stephen Hall
8a1ccee5-03e0-57f8-a392-b32c6d34ece6.text: Myself and Officer Josephine ran towards the slider and entered into the house.

532efd71-2a6e-52b7-a248-e686a314f161.speaker: Attorney Sprague
532efd71-2a6e-52b7-a248-e686a314f161.text: And when you entered into the house, do you remember what room you entered into?

f683652f-7ff5-54b4-a4ae-bc78557dbdf5.speaker: Attorney Sprague
f683652f-7ff5-54b4-a4ae-bc78557dbdf5.text: And when you entered into the kitchen, could you still hear that screaming?

7391843d-56a6-58f3-aa10-ecb8dcae898f.speaker: Stephen Hall
7391843d-56a6-58f3-aa10-ecb8dcae898f.text: No. We could hear he was talking, but there was screaming was done.

d5bf529b-9a98-5d87-a3f3-978366bbc5e6.speaker: Attorney Sprague
d5bf529b-9a98-5d87-a3f3-978366bbc5e6.text: Once you got to the bottom of the stairs, is it accurate that you either have to go right or left?

fb6e1eaf-c204-5d1e-a401-7e4660c6e594.speaker: Attorney Sprague
fb6e1eaf-c204-5d1e-a401-7e4660c6e594.text: Do you recall him saying, "I can't wake them up. I can't get them Up?"

c4adbf74-3fa0-5da7-a792-0db93a8f30be.speaker: Attorney Sprague
c4adbf74-3fa0-5da7-a792-0db93a8f30be.text: And what did you see when you got to that back room?

c724648e-4e69-58f0-ad8c-7c1bae1e2078.speaker: Stephen Hall
c724648e-4e69-58f0-ad8c-7c1bae1e2078.text: Just past the door on the left side, there was a body of a young child.

fd863cdc-587e-5823-ac01-0635756d78cf.speaker: Stephen Hall
fd863cdc-587e-5823-ac01-0635756d78cf.text: I called for paramedics to come to the basement. I also called for a supervisor and Officer Josephine picked up the child and we ran him outside through the front door to the ambulance.

8d22c261-cb10-5a5d-a51c-5b81f7d64250.speaker: Attorney Sprague
8d22c261-cb10-5a5d-a51c-5b81f7d64250.text: And did you do anything after that after giving Dawson to EMTs?

d6ec7db0-3ffc-5e38-a6de-4005415045c9.speaker: Stephen Hall
d6ec7db0-3ffc-5e38-a6de-4005415045c9.text: We ran back down into the basement to check to see if we could find other children.

c894e43b-eb63-5939-a91b-8383ab3e0672.speaker: Attorney Sprague
c894e43b-eb63-5939-a91b-8383ab3e0672.text: And what made you think there were other children to find?

724636dd-fab6-506b-af7c-9d27879a4709.speaker: Stephen Hall
724636dd-fab6-506b-af7c-9d27879a4709.text: When Patrick Clancy said, "Well, I can't wake them up," instead of just the singular.

f00b4472-1766-516b-a2fb-94e55d83ea45.speaker: Attorney Sprague
f00b4472-1766-516b-a2fb-94e55d83ea45.text: Now, when you went into that room, what did you see?

1891990e-721d-5970-adcc-2d03b58b3f2f.speaker: Stephen Hall
1891990e-721d-5970-adcc-2d03b58b3f2f.text: There were two children on the floor, motionless, and EMTs and paramedics were working on them.

df2bba94-64b6-546c-a5f3-ff8b180887d5.speaker: Attorney Sprague
df2bba94-64b6-546c-a5f3-ff8b180887d5.text: And did you receive a dispatch at approximately 6:11 PM to go to 47 Summer Street in Duxbury?

77f62355-ca21-57eb-a5fb-fcebc55f38e7.speaker: Attorney Sprague
77f62355-ca21-57eb-a5fb-fcebc55f38e7.text: And approximately how long did it take you to get there?

fe737119-35b4-5c80-a9c4-af5bbdd46fdb.speaker: Brian Josephine
fe737119-35b4-5c80-a9c4-af5bbdd46fdb.text: I would say anywhere from three to four minutes.

cb438889-ea42-5b65-ab39-f7fc33393a0c.speaker: Attorney Sprague
cb438889-ea42-5b65-ab39-f7fc33393a0c.text: Okay. And when you arrived at 47 Summer Street, what did you observe?

b3ea253e-939d-5046-a2a0-b49ccb859e1d.speaker: Brian Josephine
b3ea253e-939d-5046-a2a0-b49ccb859e1d.text: Dispatch was giving me description of the house. It took probably 15 seconds for me to identify the house. Parked in the street. I saw the number of the house and I made my way. I believe it was a mudroom that I went to.

35fff430-1195-58ee-a560-dd60d3147abd.speaker: Attorney Sprague
35fff430-1195-58ee-a560-dd60d3147abd.text: And when you came around there, what did you see?

1a9a2524-4f52-58d2-a40b-d890af47add1.speaker: Brian Josephine
1a9a2524-4f52-58d2-a40b-d890af47add1.text: I made my way. I observed two parties, one lying in the ground and one standing over it. And I started to make my way towards the other end of the house, which is as towards this fence, as you guys can see in reference to that photo.

bf5cea5e-fe26-525a-a2b4-833150840ea3.speaker: Attorney Sprague
bf5cea5e-fe26-525a-a2b4-833150840ea3.text: And the person that was standing, did you later learn that was Patrick Clancy?

95e2639c-323e-56f6-a6ca-150c9160f2f9.speaker: Attorney Sprague
95e2639c-323e-56f6-a6ca-150c9160f2f9.text: And the person on the ground, did you later learn that was Lindsay Clancy?

522853e6-440e-5ee7-a71f-8696242c11b3.speaker: Brian Josephine
522853e6-440e-5ee7-a71f-8696242c11b3.text:
‍

He was standing over Lindsay at that point. It appeared that he was trying to communicate with her. I observed him with a cell phone. It was kind of down by his side, so I don't know if they were talking or what, but it was probably a split second, and then he turned to my location, saw me because I was illuminating the yard with my flashlight, and then that's when me and him crossed paths.

0c31476b-abe1-5f54-a6fe-22f2f102eed0.speaker: Attorney Sprague
0c31476b-abe1-5f54-a6fe-22f2f102eed0.text: And after you crossed paths with Patrick, where did you go?

d51800e8-8766-56e0-a79d-f8de558d6959.speaker: Brian Josephine
d51800e8-8766-56e0-a79d-f8de558d6959.text: I went to the female party.

a9f07912-e4e1-5130-a974-af26984320d3.speaker: Brian Josephine
a9f07912-e4e1-5130-a974-af26984320d3.text: Yes. So I would say I tried to talk to Ms. Clancy for probably 30 seconds to a minute. And at that point, coming from that opposite side of the house, I observed Duxbury Fire personnel show up. And our protocol is to kind of turn the medical over to them because they're more highly trained than we are.

81af8657-1c96-58eb-ac76-20f3047e8b3e.speaker: Shanan Buckingham
81af8657-1c96-58eb-ac76-20f3047e8b3e.text: Okay. And at some point in time, do you hear something?

6368e6e9-87ba-5ee9-aa89-aa5f084d284a.speaker: Brian Josephine
6368e6e9-87ba-5ee9-aa89-aa5f084d284a.text: Myself and Officer Hall were standing by that window and we just started hearing loud screams.

9c971f97-b61b-56ea-a100-9c469204dbc6.speaker: Shanan Buckingham
9c971f97-b61b-56ea-a100-9c469204dbc6.text: And what did you do when you heard those loud screams?

3be2266f-4c39-5832-adc3-c572b366c29e.speaker: Brian Josephine
3be2266f-4c39-5832-adc3-c572b366c29e.text: We immediately were trying to figure out where they were coming from. I'm not sure if dispatch or something came over the air and said something about the basement, but we both just started making our way back towards the deck part of the house.

cecbff89-282f-5383-aa74-44e617644382.speaker: Brian Josephine
cecbff89-282f-5383-aa74-44e617644382.text: Yes. We went up the deck and through the sliding glass doors into the kitchen.

86531d9a-7f5d-54ea-a9b2-9783ed17eaf6.speaker: Shanan Buckingham
86531d9a-7f5d-54ea-a9b2-9783ed17eaf6.text: Okay. And could you hear any sounds coming from the basement as you entered the kitchen?

48478ab7-d5ed-5152-afc2-87cf5c28e37f.speaker: Brian Josephine
48478ab7-d5ed-5152-afc2-87cf5c28e37f.text: Yes, it was the exact screaming that I heard from the window.

86c7e5e2-1c02-5760-ab33-e23269df8af0.speaker: Shanan Buckingham
86c7e5e2-1c02-5760-ab33-e23269df8af0.text: And did you see anything after you went down the stairs?

6aef0285-3ff2-5173-a9cd-3da9360110a5.speaker: Brian Josephine
6aef0285-3ff2-5173-a9cd-3da9360110a5.text: Upon his observation of us, myself and Officer Hall, he proceeded to head in our direction, leaving that room. And at that point he looked up and he screamed, "She killed the fucking kids."

fd444089-77cb-5f11-a492-ce6d52e68efc.speaker: Shanan Buckingham
fd444089-77cb-5f11-a492-ce6d52e68efc.text: And after he said that, where did you go?

81849fe9-82de-5a86-a6fb-886ce479cd88.speaker: Brian Josephine
81849fe9-82de-5a86-a6fb-886ce479cd88.text: Once he cleared himself from the doorframe, we were able to look inside the room where we observed what appeared to be a child laying motionless on the floor.

e52d8169-1c2e-5ba1-a41f-2365bd48b785.speaker: Shanan Buckingham
e52d8169-1c2e-5ba1-a41f-2365bd48b785.text: And did you later learn his name was Dawson Clancy?

e11698ca-40e8-5d85-a981-798811babca8.speaker: Shanan Buckingham
e11698ca-40e8-5d85-a981-798811babca8.text: And once you saw him there with these injuries, what did you do?

d4d505c7-e395-5fe1-a1db-358d683e9001.speaker: Brian Josephine
d4d505c7-e395-5fe1-a1db-358d683e9001.text: Based on my observations, I knew there wasn't really much I could do. So I picked the child up, went chest to chest. And as I did that, it was kind of like a mucus or a foam that leaked out of his mouth onto me. I grabbed him, went back towards the way. We came down into the basement and I headed up to the stairs where Sergeant Homestead was coming down the stairs and I started yelling to him to get out of the way. Went back up the stairs and then into the kitchen directly adjacent to the stairs is the front foyer hallway, and I went out that, out the main door into the driveway.

4904b499-e452-5650-aea9-f9e9736e3029.speaker: Brian Josephine
4904b499-e452-5650-aea9-f9e9736e3029.text: Yes. The ambulance was backing up and had pretty much just parked and one of the fire was walking around to the stretcher out back. So I rushed over with Dawson and I put him on the stretcher and that's when Sergeant Homestead and fire personnel started working further on him.

a6e73260-9981-5c77-a4a2-5dadeb753872.speaker: Brian Josephine
a6e73260-9981-5c77-a4a2-5dadeb753872.text: I went back into the house.

60c69f63-7e83-5402-adb0-5ac0062bb68d.speaker: Brian Josephine
60c69f63-7e83-5402-adb0-5ac0062bb68d.text: Yes, I went back in that front door, back down to the basement, and this time I went to the left-hand side.

e3e2ef1b-e7c9-5b1c-af7d-d6d1065fcb71.speaker: Brian Josephine
e3e2ef1b-e7c9-5b1c-af7d-d6d1065fcb71.text: So when I got down to the basement, two fire personnel were already on scene. One was working on the baby and one was working on Cora. Communicated with them. We worked together and I took over doing chest compressions of Cora.

dbf836a9-bf9c-505a-a0f9-49233cda3df2.speaker: Shanan Buckingham
dbf836a9-bf9c-505a-a0f9-49233cda3df2.text: And, eventually, was Cora put on a stretcher and brought out?

8f23f35f-b3b5-541f-aa04-0535d98d50da.speaker: Brian Josephine
8f23f35f-b3b5-541f-aa04-0535d98d50da.text: Yes, eventually. I think the baby was brought out first because I think they mentioned at some point they might've found a faint pulse or something like that, so they got him out first and then we were able to get Cora out.
